steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Roman legion was the basic military unit of about 5,000 men, divided into 10 cohorts of 6 centuries of 80 men each

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Legionaries carried a pilum (javelin) and gladius (short sword); the pilum's soft iron shank bent on impact, making shields unusable

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Roman engineering: roads (over 400,000 km of roads connecting the empire), aqueducts (gravity-fed water supply), and fortifications like Hadrian's Wall

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Hadrian's Wall (122 AD) was a 117 km defensive wall across northern Britain, marking the northwest frontier of the empire
